status: Declared before initial closed-loop campaign; predictor replay audit already available separately.

mpc.kind: frozen local affine MPC; no guaranteed nonlinear configuration planning

acceptance.all: no physical failure; hard applied-input bounds respected; useful original-goal recovery; fallback active samples <=5 percent
acceptance.weak_y: final original-goal error <=5mm, no worse peak reference-relative lean and lower lean-error integral plus lower original-clock path RMS than matched baseline
acceptance.strong_x: no greater than10 percent path-RMS regression and no worse peak lean; final original-goal error <=5mm
acceptance.not_accepted: Frozen/stalled travel, mostly LQR fallback, success inferred only from QP bound compliance
acceptance.runtime: offline wall-time measured, no real-time claim; no runtime gate for physics proof-of-concept

prediction_screen_reference.scope: Proposed diagnostic tolerances; prior recorded-input audit passed. Optimized400msplans must be checked separately; a frozen model may omit phase×drive benefits.
